race.comment: REACH THE PEAK (5) is the horse to beat after completing a hat-trick in the NR 58 to 69 at Globe Derby Park, where he started favourite, won by just under two metres and rated a strong 1:56.3 mile rate. His prior win came here in an NR 50 to 59 by just over nine metres, and the Wayne Hill combination is a major strength. ROCKNROLL SPIRIT (3) profiles as the main danger after finishing third, beaten just over a metre, in the similar NR 55 to 64 last week, with his previous 1:56.5 win showing he has the right speed for this. ALORA (1) gets the ace draw and has a genuine case after chasing the top pick home last start, and her Port Pirie track-and-distance record is a positive. CLASSIC LINE (6) has been narrowly denied in two strong recent races, including a nose defeat in a sharp 1:55.1 mile rate, but he must turn those placings into a winning punch.
